items.title: Trump envoys to meet Putin in Moscow after latest Ukraine talks end with no breakthrough
items.brief: President Donald Trump’s son-in-law Jared Kushner said Wednesday he and Middle East envoy Steve Witkoff would travel to Moscow after talks in Abu Dhabi to end the Ukraine war ended with no clear breakthrough.

items.title: Bomb threats prompt evacuation of Italian schools in suspected hoax as UK and Ireland also targeted
items.brief: Hundreds of schools were evacuated in Italy on Wednesday after bomb threats were sent via email, police told CNN, becoming the latest in a series of threats and cyberattacks targeting infrastructure across Europe.

items.title: How each House member voted on the impeachment of Pete Hegseth
items.brief: The House of Representatives voted on Tuesday evening to send an effort to impeach Pete Hegseth to committee, effectively killing the movement to oust the defense secretary before the end of the year.

items.title: A missing baby was found buried alive a day after authorities say his father took him
items.brief: A South Carolina infant who authorities say was taken by his father was found alive Tuesday, buried in a dog crate in the woods after apparently spending about 24 hours underground, officials said.

items.title: First snow, coldest air in months headed for eastern US in wake of storm
items.brief: Winter will make its first cameo in the eastern United States later this week as a storm ushers in the coldest temperatures in six months for tens of millions of people and the first snow for some.
